- Discount: yes — we can offer a 12% introductory committed discount for the first 3 months on a 12-month committed agreement at the $30k/mo run-rate you mentioned. I will document this in the commercial term sheet once you confirm intent to proceed.
- Change log: I’ll send the v1.2 change log with the full rate card (now that NDA is executed). It calls out model variant swaps and kernel-level performance improvements in 1.2 vs 1.1.
